description: Piano delle Dighe is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agenzia per l'Italia Digitale. Plan for the identification of risk scenarios related to the presence of dams and dams on watercourses in the provincial territory: potentially unfathomable areas in the event of collapse of the dam works Consists of a single table with provincial cover. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Dam Plan" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Specchi d’acqua. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
